title: Geometric stalks of a sheaf of modules of finite type are finitely generated
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] which is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-etale-module-finite-type]. Let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ the stalk of the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], a $\Lambda$-module by $\lambda\cdot(\text{germ of }s)=\text{germ of }\lambda s$. Then $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ is a finitely generated $\Lambda$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. More precisely: if $u:U\to Y$ is etale, $\mathcal G|_U$ is generated by the global sections $s_1,\dots,s_n\in\mathcal G(U)$ and $\bar u$ is a geometric point of $U$ with $u\circ\bar u=\bar y$, then $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ is generated by the germs of $s_1,\dots,s_n$ at the pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$.

proof.text: For the localized site Y_et/U, the epimorphism π is locally surjective directly in the concrete coefficient category ModuleCat Λ, using Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' from the Mathlib match of lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective (the theorem is generic in the coefficient category). The sheafification unit η of the constant presheaf with arbitrary module value M is locally surjective by the Mathlib match of lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaf-sections-locally-constant, applied to this over topology. Therefore η ≫ π.hom is locally surjective by Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_comp.

Represent an arbitrary stalk element z by t over a pointed neighborhood (V,b), using Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective. The filtered-colimit preservation instance is shrunk from universe u+1 to u. Cofilteredness gives (W,w) mapping to both (V,b) and (U,a). Regard W → U as an object T of Over U, with w in the fiber of the point ψ = (pointSmallEtale y).over a. Restrict t to T. Apply ψ.jointly_surjective to the covering image sieve of η ≫ π.hom: obtain R → T, a pointed lift d, and m ∈ M whose image is the restriction of t. This lifts the whole constant-module section in one step.

Naturality of η ≫ π.hom along R → (U,id) identifies its value at R on m with restriction of its value at the terminal object on the same m, since the source presheaf is constant. Point.toPresheafFiber_w along R → U, R → W, and W → V then identifies its germ at (U,a) with z. Thus the composite M → G(U) → G_y is surjective. This is the fully proved private helper germ_constant_epi_surjective.

Take M = (Fin n → Λ). For every c ∈ M, the pointwise identity c = sum_j c(j) • Pi.single j 1 holds, including n=0. Apply the linear germ composite L and its preservation of sums and scalar multiplication. Each L(Pi.single j 1) lies in the span of their range, so surjectivity of L proves that this span is top. This is the fully proved private helper germ_constant_epi_span.

Unpack IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf G to a jointly surjective etale covering 𝒰 with a finite free generating epimorphism on each member. Choose i and x over y(default) by Cover.exists_eq, then lift y to a : Spec Ω → 𝒰.X i by exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed. Apply the preceding spanning assertion with the resulting fiber element b = Over.homMk a ha. Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family constructs FG of the top submodule and hence Module.Finite. Return this together with the universal spanning assertion, without changing the public signature.

lean.statement: theorem finite_geometric_stalk_of_isFiniteType {Y : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hG : IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf G) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) : Module.Finite Λ (((pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj G) ∧ ∀ (U : Y.Etale) (a : (pointSmallEtale y).fiber.obj U) (n : ℕ) (π : (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (ModuleCat.of Λ (Fin n → Λ)) ⟶ G.over U) [Epi π], Submodule.span Λ (M := ((pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj G) (Set.range fun j : Fin n ↦ ((pointSmallEtale y).toPresheafFiber U a G.obj).hom ((π.hom.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom (((toSheafify (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over U) ((Functor.const (Over U)ᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of Λ (Fin n → Λ)))).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom (Pi.single j 1)))) = ⊤
lean.note: Reviewer R-fts1031 fix: restated in the Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u+1} Λ) encoding with the recorded IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf of the stmt_dep def-weil-pbc-etale-module-finite-type (STATE two encodings: proper-base-change/constructible area). The stalk is (pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.obj G with its ModuleCat Λ structure, the canonical germwise action. 'G|_U generated by s_1..s_n' is an epimorphism π from the constant sheaf of Fin n → Λ on the localised site, s_j the image of the j-th basis section at Over.mk (𝟙 U); n = 0 gives the zero stalk.
